nodes.text: I'm mapping this stretch of stone. The pool ahead is a Perpendicularity: a gate between realms.

choices.label: What will I see in the other realm?

nodes.text: Step into the pool to shift realms. To shift back, walk clear of its edge and enter again.

choices.label: What does Roshar look like there?

nodes.text: On Roshar, Shadesmar's land is a sea of glass beads. Non-living objects appear as dark beads, living things as flames, and water as solid obsidian. The sky is black with one frail, fixed white sun.
It is another reading of this same place. The view changes; your position and the world beneath it do not.
